title: POST /api/fleet/enroll request body
description: Exactly one of `code` (one-time enrollment code, RUE-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) or `key` (reusable fleet enrollment key, rfk_<id>_<secret>). A server that enrolls again with the same install_id gets its existing record back. FLEET.md §4.1.

name.description: suggested display name (key enrollment), e.g. the server-N directory
